part.text:
The images are ready. ✅

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the workspace defines exactly one view, so there's one image:

- **System Context View: Library** (700×370 SVG)
  - `Patron` [Person] → `Library` [Software System], labeled *"Browses the catalogue through"* `[HTTPS]`
  - Standard C4 styling: teal person, blue system, icons, and a legend

One note on method: this environment has no PlantUML/Java/Node and no network access, so I couldn't run a stock renderer or produce PNGs. Instead I exported the view to C4-PlantUML via the Structurizr tooling and generated the SVG directly from that definition (official C4 colors/shapes), which your "PNG (or SVG)" allowance covers. The file is well-formed XML and opens in any browser or image viewer.

If you later add a `container` view to `workspace.dsl`, I can render it the same way.
